title: Expandable dev indicator on Day screen

waves.title: Implement and accept Day dev runtime disclosure
waves.goal: Land the bounded frontend slice, prove dev-expanded and prod-inert behavior, and close with verifier, reviewer, and architect evidence.
verification_commands: corepack pnpm --dir frontend exec jest --runInBand test/app/home-page.test.tsx
acceptance_criteria: Compact DEV chip remains local and non-banner-like in collapsed state.
On `/` in non-production, tapping the chip expands and collapses a disclosure with render path, bootstrap result, and current mode only.
Production branch remains inert and visually unchanged.
Verifier evidence includes dev-collapsed and dev-expanded screenshots plus an explicit observability verdict.
deferred_work: Any broader shell diagnostics surface beyond the Day route.
Any additional runtime fields beyond render path, bootstrap result, and current mode.
